selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main change in the world is described as happening every fall and every spring?
questions.answer: In fall, a world of living things passes away, and in spring, a new world of living things appears.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of deaths and new creations within these seasons?
questions.answer: It says there are many separate ones, all happening in an organized way.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare the world to a place where travelers stop briefly?
questions.answer: Because beings stay only for a limited time, complete their tasks, and then depart.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Creator’s way of making these living worlds?
questions.answer: He makes them with perfect wisdom, knowledge, balance, order, and regularity.

questions.question: What is the main point of the section about contingence?
questions.answer: Created things depend on a chooser because they could have been many other ways.

questions.question: What does the passage say about how widespread contingence is?
questions.answer: It is found throughout the whole cosmos.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the attributes and organs given to created things?
questions.answer: They are especially suited, useful, and wise, not random or pointless.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do they show about the Creator’s wisdom?
questions.answer: They show that His wisdom reaches everything in a precise way.

questions.question: Which example shows that creating something huge is easy for Allah?
questions.answer: Bringing forth a whole spring.

questions.question: What central belief is the passage strengthening through these examples?
questions.answer: Belief that Allah alone creates and governs everything with power and wisdom.

questions.question: What yearly pattern in nature is highlighted at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: A vast dying in autumn and a fresh coming-to-life in spring.

questions.question: What happens in spring?
questions.answer: A fresh living world is brought forth.

questions.question: Which qualities show that these are made with care?
questions.answer: They are made with wisdom, knowledge, balance, order, and regularity.

questions.question: Which qualities are named to describe His creating?
questions.answer: Wisdom, knowledge, balance, order, and regularity.

questions.question: Why is giving one exact form to a thing important in the argument?
questions.answer: Because many forms were possible, so choosing one fitting form shows deliberate choice.

questions.question: What does giving beneficial organs show about creation?
questions.answer: It shows careful planning, usefulness, and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s relation to hidden things?
questions.answer: Nothing at all is hidden from Him.

questions.question: What image sums up the universe’s witness to Allah in this passage?
questions.answer: The universe is giving a great testimony, and contingence is one of its two wings.

questions.question: What two seasons are used to show repeated change in the world?
questions.answer: Autumn and spring.

questions.question: What is important about the way these events happen?
questions.answer: They happen with exact order and steady regularity.

questions.question: Which range of things is included when the passage speaks about all beings?
questions.answer: It includes everything from the highest created levels to the earth, and from the tiniest particles to huge heavenly bodies.

questions.question: Why does choosing one essence from many possibilities point beyond the thing itself?
questions.answer: Because the thing could not choose itself from endless options, so a chooser must have specified it.

questions.question: What does the giving of useful organs add to the argument?
questions.answer: It shows not just choice, but wise and purposeful choice.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s awareness of every object and matter?
questions.answer: Every object and matter is fully known to Him.
